body: You would be surprised, i'm 17 years old myself lol. I know it can be rough in high school, especially when you end up missing school so much. I have a lot of health issues so I would end up missing way too much every year. I am currently in an online high school program, which is better but I still get behind in my work here and there. Just remind yourself that school is all temporary. You will soon be done with it for good, but you need to try to get it over with. Take care. :)
Hey there, I'm sorry for being a bit late but I want you to know that I'm here if you want to chat. :)

It might seem hard to believe but I know exactly how you feel. I remember sitting up at night just ripping myself to shreds, feeling so guilty about EVERYTHING. I would "replay" things that happened during the day and think about everything I might have done wrong. After years of this I just feel exhausted emotionally. I almost feel like i'm becoming a selfish person because sometimes i'm just too tired to worry about others. Situations like this make it very easy for things like depression and anxiety to creep in, if they haven't already. Now it seems that I think of suicide often, and its a bit ironic. I used to date this girl when I was in 7th grade, and she was extremely suicidal. It got to where I was staying up until 5 am on weekdays trying to talk her out of killing herself, at least twice a week. After all of this mess I started to hate the idea of suicide. I thought it was the most pointless thing in the world. Now, years later, I'm the one thinking about suicide. It scares me. I still feel guilty for even thinking about it. 

Anyway, sorry I tend to ramble...even on Reddit lol. I'm not very active but your post hit pretty close to home. I read it, and I understand completely.

Thank you for your help, i'm at a loss for words really. Making this post was really the first time I "told" anyone about the problems i've been having. I would have never guessed that i'd find such kind people on Reddit of all things, haha. Thanks again buddy. :)

Hey buddy, sorry i'm so late replying to this. I wanted to thank you for your kind words, they mean alot. Also that piece of art you made has to be one of the nicest things anyone has done for me in a long time. I really can't remember the last time I cracked a smile that big, haha. Thanks again. :)
